titles.C09: Matched signature (part's own signal + own error)

C09.rule: ((volt 6h trailing mean > P99 of normal operation (its own machine)) AND (error1 count in last 24h > P80 of normal operation (all machines))) OR ((rotate 6h trailing mean < P1 of normal operation (its own machine)) AND (error2+error3 count in last 24h > P80 of normal operation (all machines))) OR ((pressure 6h trailing mean > P99 of normal operation (its own machine)) AND (error4 count in last 24h > P80 of normal operation (all machines))) OR ((vibration 6h trailing mean > P99 of normal operation (its own machine)) AND (error5 count in last 24h > P80 of normal operation (all machines)))

C08.rule: (any of [volt ↑, rotate ↓, pressure ↑, vibration ↑]: 6h trailing mean beyond median ± 3.72×MAD-σ of its own machine's normal operation, in the arrow's direction) AND (error-log count in last 48h > P80 of normal operation (all machines))

C10.rule: ((volt 6h trailing mean > median + 3.72×MAD-σ of its own machine's normal operation) AND (hours since maint. of comp1 hourly reading > P50 of normal operation (all machines))) OR ((rotate 6h trailing mean < median − 3.72×MAD-σ of its own machine's normal operation) AND (hours since maint. of comp2 hourly reading > P50 of normal operation (all machines))) OR ((pressure 6h trailing mean > median + 3.72×MAD-σ of its own machine's normal operation) AND (hours since maint. of comp3 hourly reading > P50 of normal operation (all machines))) OR ((vibration 6h trailing mean > median + 3.72×MAD-σ of its own machine's normal operation) AND (hours since maint. of comp4 hourly reading > P50 of normal operation (all machines)))
